{{Quote|When the Empire abducts men of the streets for their experiments, it offends us all, no?|translated=1|Damrosch the Hutt|<ref name="Tempting Fate" />}}
'''Damrosch''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who allied the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Tempting Fate" /> He believed that [[Betterlife Pharmaceuticals]] was a front company of an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] research group, but needed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to help him prove it.<ref name="Tempting Fate" />

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] period, Damrosch the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was already a very influential resident of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and he could be usually seen at the [[Lower Industrial Sector|Lower Industrial]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], where he managed to build a [[Damrosch the Hutt's factory|factory]].

He became convinced that [[Betterlife Pharmaceuticals]] was an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] front organization when he realized that they were abducting men of the streets for their experiments, an action which he found offensive. Since he had no way to prove it, he requested help from an individual, instructing him to steal an access card from one of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] inside Betterlife Pharmaceuticals and use it to access one of their security terminals and get all the information needed.
